skills.name: Military Farm
skills.text: Whenever Deng Ai loses cards outside his turn, he can flip a judgment. If it is not a heart, it becomes a Farm, and he acquires it. Each Farm Deng Ai has grants him a -1 horse.

skills.name: Strategic Pass
skills.text: Awakened Ability: When Deng Ai starts his turn with three or more Farms, he must decrease his maximum health level by one. He then permanently gains the ability to use his Farms as Steals.

source.site: English Sanguosha (Jason Keeney and Scott Maresh)
